description: Ephemeral run target. ADR #1575 (Accepted) selects verification hands: an ephemeral per-worker container from the project image, with the worktree mounted and no credentials. This plan builds step 1 of its sequence: the `ephemeral` target and one `agro` verb. Facts: `ExecutionTarget` in `.agro/cli/src/lib/execution/target.ts` has three kinds. The AGRO image runs user `sandbox` with uid 1000. The VM user `sandbox` has uid 1001. `pnpm test` on this VM fails 14 tests because of umask `0077` and a missing `zsh`.

userStories.title: Ephemeral execution target
userStories.description: As a worker on an AGRO VM, I want a disposable container target so that a check runs without host drift or host credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/cli/src/lib/execution/ephemeral-target.ts` exports `EphemeralExecutionTarget` with `kind = "ephemeral"` that implements `ExecutionTarget` from `target.ts`.
`exec` runs `docker run --rm` with the worktree mounted at its host path, the working directory set to the request `cwd`, and `--user <host uid>:<host gid>`.
The container mounts no Docker socket, no home directory, and no path other than the worktree. The container receives only the environment keys in the request `env`.
Tests in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/ephemeral-target.test.ts` assert the exact `docker` argument vector through a fake runner, including the absence of the socket and home mounts.
`pnpm typecheck` exits 0, and `pnpm test` shows no new failure against `evidence/baseline.md`.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, 556eb8d1 after repair round 1): typecheck 0; CLI build 0; agro run -- pnpm test: 13 failed / 2912 passed (was 78); passwd/group mounted read-only from a temp dir removed in finally; git common dir mounted for worktrees only; tests 31/31. Remaining 13: 12 remote-sandbox-adapters (python3 lives in /opt/home-seed, unreadable for the host uid without the entrypoint), 1 install.test.ts (host checkout file mode under umask 0077).

userStories.title: The `agro run` verb
userStories.description: As a worker, I want one `agro` verb that runs a command in the ephemeral target so that `agro` stays the only lifecycle door.
acceptanceCriteria: `agro run [--image <ref>] -- <command...>` runs the command in `EphemeralExecutionTarget` from the current directory and exits with the exit code of the command.
The image is `--image` when given, else `image.ref` in `agro.json`, else the official image for the CLI version.
Inside a sandbox, `agro run` exits 1 with the `HostOnlyError` message.
Tests cover argument parsing, the image order, the exit code, and the sandbox refusal.
`pnpm typecheck` exits 0, and `pnpm test` shows no new failure against the baseline.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, fd2ab4cb): typecheck 0; run.test.ts + ephemeral-target.test.ts 26/26; CLI build 0; real run of the built CLI: agro run -- sh -c "id -u; echo ok" printed 1001 and ok, exit 0. worker: pnpm test shows only the 14 baseline failures. Repair: command-table.ts added to owned files (verb registry) after one BLOCKED report.

userStories.title: Documentation and changelog
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `agro run` in the verb reference and the changelog so that the new verb is discoverable.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/lifecycle-commands.md` holds one verb-table row and one section for `agro run`, with the mount and credential limits.
`CHANGELOG.md` holds one entry under `## [Unreleased]` that links the task issue.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, merged 4b0c32e6): docs.test.ts + compose-verbs.test.ts 41/41; ste-check finding on lifecycle-commands.md is pre-existing at line 485, none on added lines; CHANGELOG Added entry links #1579. reasoned: docs section matches run.ts and ephemeral-target.ts (host only, docker run --rm, image order, root mount, host uid, HOME=/tmp, no host variables, socket, or home, default network, exit code, ADR #1575).

userStories.title: ADR #1575 step 1 validation
userStories.description: As the operator, I want proof that `agro run` removes host drift so that ADR #1575 step 1 meets its validation rule.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/ephemeral-run-target/evidence/manual-review.md` records `agro run -- pnpm test` from the harness root on this VM, with the exit code and the test summary.
Each baseline failure that the host umask or a missing host tool causes does not occur in the `agro run` result.
The `agro run` result has no failure that the host result does not have.
The transcript records each remaining failure that a host checkout file mode causes as host checkout drift.
The transcript records the wall time of `agro run -- pnpm test` and of the host `pnpm test`.
userStories.notes: Evidence cfdd0d09: agro run -- pnpm test 78 failed vs host 14; 13 of 14 baseline failures gone; causes recorded. Re-run after US-001 repair.

userStories.title: The image ships a system python3
userStories.description: As a worker, I want a system `python3` in the AGRO image so that scripts that need `python3` run under `agro run`.
acceptanceCriteria: `.devcontainer/Dockerfile` installs a system `python3` through `apt-get`, and the build fails when `/usr/bin/python3` is absent.
For the `sandbox` user after the normal boot, `python3` still resolves to the uv Python 3.13, so `.agro/scripts/verify-sandbox-image.sh` passes on a local build.
`docker build --target final -f .devcontainer/Dockerfile -t agro-local:1579 .` exits 0.
userStories.notes: executed (worker): docker build --target final -t agro-local:1579 exit 0; verify-sandbox-image.sh agro-local:1579 exit 0 (sandbox user python3 still uv 3.13). executed (advisor): agro run --image agro-local:1579 prints /usr/bin/python3 and Python 3.13.5. Dockerfile diff adds python3-minimal and test -x /usr/bin/python3; DL3008 ignored per .hadolint.yaml.
